remarks: Immaculately kept and updated with quality, love and care, this top floor Eastside Commons unit with 2 bedrooms, 2 baths and a finished loft and sizable finished storage room, awaits a new discerning buyer. The unit boasts new wood-like flooring throughout the eat-in kitchen area and living room with its dramatic 9'+ ceiling and large light-streaming picture windows. The kitchen cabinets are newly refinished in white, in contrast to the dark granite countertops and all hardware here and in the bathrooms have been replaced. The open feeling upon entry makes a wonderful first impression. Both bedrooms are generously sized and offer great closets. The primary bedroom features an ensuite bathroom and has a slider to the balcony, overlooking the professionally landscaped gardens and grilling area. The newly refinished staircase leads to the loft and storage room which is finished so it can be used as extra living space. These owners have recently painted the entire interior and installed not only the new floors but a totally new central air conditioning system and new hot water heater. The complex offers residents many amenities such as a fitness center, a spacious courtyard, common areas for socializing, a concierge, 2 elevators and a parking garage.
